payload.blocks: Landing branch component-authority-doors/p02a-fix (cf2cf83a7) and closing phase 11 step 6. Phase 10b keeps going in its worktree meanwhile.
payload.headline: Run fgos git recover on main so the doors lead can land the doctor --only fix?

parts.cause: fgos git recover needs the merge-slot lock, which is read-only inside confined heads (the lead's and the supervisor's). No unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is live to run it.

options.does: Run `fgos git recover` in /home/vantt/projects/forgent, then answer; the supervisor tells the lead to land again.
options.gain: Unblocks the land in one command.
options.label: A. Owner runs fgos git recover now

options.cost: A few minutes plus the session.
options.does: Owner starts the unconfined supervisor session; it runs recover and stays for later host-only chores.
options.gain: Future host-only chores have a door.
options.harm: One more live session to watch.
options.label: B. Start a lead:SUPERVISOR session to run it

parts.recommendation: A: one command clears it; nothing else needs an unconfined session right now.

scope.allows: Recovering that one pending land operation on main.
scope.forbids: Any other git operation, branch reset or worktree removal.

parts.what: A land of p02a-fix died at 02:25 when the root disk was full and left the git journal operation land-358453-1795461790719303262-1 pending. The disk now has 15 GB free. The lead's retry is refused land-abandoned-writer-mismatch until the journal is recovered.
